Bug_Title: DP: Classloaders should only be created inside doPrivileged block (DP_CREATE_CLASSLOADER_INSIDE_DO_PRIVILEGED)
Bug_Details:
This code creates a classloader,  which needs permission if a security manage is installed.
If this code might be invoked by code that does not
have security permissions, then the classloader creation needs to occur inside a doPrivileged block. java.security.AccessController doPrivileged
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by creating a URLClassLoader outside of a doPrivileged block. This violates the rule that classloaders should only be created inside a doPrivileged block when a security manager is installed.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with a null URL array, which attempts to create a URLClassLoader without being inside a doPrivileged block. This will throw a SecurityException if a security manager is installed.
